content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe how lactic acid is processed after exercise
Interpret graphs showing oxygen consumption during and after exercise

(now often called EPOC - Excess Post-exercise Oxygen Consumption) is the extra oxygen the body needs after exercise to recover. It explains why we continue breathing heavily after exercise stops and how the body deals with lactic acid.
The extra oxygen required after exercise to restore the body to its resting state
